title: Organization authentication
description: Sign-in settings for the realm of {tenant}: registration, sign-in, password recovery, email verification and the configured identity providers.

methodsDescription: Choose how users can access the realm of your organization.

registrationAllowed.label: Allow user registration
registrationAllowed.help: Users can create their own account from the sign-in screen.

loginWithEmailAllowed.label: Allow sign-in with email
loginWithEmailAllowed.help: Users can sign in with their email address as well as their username.

resetPasswordAllowed.label: Allow password recovery
resetPasswordAllowed.help: Users can request a link to reset their password.

rememberMe.label: Allow “remember me”
rememberMe.help: Users can stay signed in between visits.

verifyEmail.label: Require email verification
verifyEmail.help: New users must verify their email address before they can sign in.
